<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M+1 peak (~10 % of the base peak) indicating the presence of carbon, and a pronounced M+2 peak (~24 % of the base peak) with a ratio close to the natural 35Cl/37Cl pattern, allowing us to definitively identify chlorine. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic pattern strong enough to be certain.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
